attributes.name: Norwegian Elkhound
attributes.description: The Norwegian Elkhound is an ancient breed of Spitz-type hunting and guard dog from Norway. They are strong and powerful, yet friendly and loyal. Norwegian Elkhounds have a thick, double coat with a long, profuse undercoat and a short, thick outer coat. They come in various colors, including black and grey. They are independent and intelligent, and make great family pets.
